SELECT SEARCH_PAGE_ID, MENU1_DEPTH_NAME, MENU2_DEPTH_NAME, MENU3_DEPTH_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, PAGE_URL FROM ( SELECT 0 AS SRC_ORDER, S.SRCH_PAGE_SN AS SEARCH_PAGE_ID, S.MENU_1DEPTH_NM AS MENU1_DEPTH_NAME, S.MENU_2DEPTH_NM AS MENU2_DEPTH_NAME, S.MENU_3DEPTH_NM AS MENU3_DEPTH_NAME, S.PAGE_TTL AS TITLE, S.PAGE_CN AS CONTENT, S.PAGE_URL AS PAGE_URL, S.REG_DT AS SORT_DT FROM HMPG_SEARCH_PAGE S WHERE S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( S.PAGE_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR S.PAGE_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR S.MENU_1DEPTH_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR S.MENU_2DEPTH_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR S.MENU_3DEPTH_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') )
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS SRC_ORDER, -ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC, A.PST_SN) AS SEARCH_PAGE_ID, CASE A.BBS_ID WHEN 'LBARC' THEN '도서관' ELSE '소식' END AS MENU1_DEPTH_NAME, M.BBS_NM AS MENU2_DEPTH_NAME, NULL AS MENU3_DEPTH_NAME, A.PST_TTL AS TITLE, LEFT(A.PST_CN, 500) AS CONTENT, CASE A.BBS_ID WHEN 'ZEHSB' THEN CONCAT('/news/notice_view?id=', A.PST_SN) WHEN 'EXHBT' THEN CONCAT('/news/exhibit_view?id=', A.PST_SN) WHEN 'EVENT' THEN CONCAT('/news/event_view?id=', A.PST_SN)
WHEN 'GALRY' THEN CONCAT('/news/gallery?post_id=', A.PST_SN) WHEN 'FAQ01' THEN '/news/faq' WHEN 'LBARC' THEN CONCAT('/library/archive_view?id=', A.PST_SN) ELSE NULL END AS PAGE_URL, A.REG_DT AS SORT_DT FROM BBS_ARTICLE A JOIN BBS_MST M ON M.BBS_ID = A.BBS_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.LCK_YN <> 'Y'
AND (A.PSTG_YMD IS NULL OR A.PSTG_YMD = '' OR A.PSTG_YMD <= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')) AND A.BBS_ID IN ('ZEHSB', 'EXHBT', 'EVENT', 'GALRY', 'FAQ01', 'LBARC') AND ( A.PST_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') OR A.PST_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{value}, '%') ) ) R WHERE R.PAGE_URL IS NOT NULL ORDER BY R.SRC_ORDER, R.MENU1_DEPTH_NAME, R.MENU2_DEPTH_NAME, R.MENU3_DEPTH_NAME, R.SORT_DT DESC, R.SEARCH_PAGE_ID DESC LIMIT 500
